description: This source file defines the class PdfSignaturePlaceholderItem, which is used to represent a placeholder for a digital signature within a PDF processing library. The class includes properties and methods related to the size and position of the signature placeholder in the PDF stream.

classes.name: PdfSignaturePlaceholderItem
classes.description: A sealed class representing a placeholder for a digital signature in a PDF. It includes size, position, and string representation relevant to the signature placeholder.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string with question marks padded to the size of the signature placeholder, intended to indicate an unfilled placeholder.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Writes the signature placeholder to a PDF stream through a PdfWriter instance.
